title: Usability, glitch & reliability audit — direct users, 5 personas
subtitle: Staging build · Arjun, Emily, Mark, Rahul, Suresh · no partner
summary: Most confusion comes from three patterns: status chips that look like buttons, icon-only chat actions with no labels, and AI replies that show nothing for 2–4 seconds. On the health partner, a Tax agent from the finance vertical is visible to patients.

scorecard.journey: Get the Germany MS checklist and save it

patterns.title: Status chips look like buttons
patterns.description: Filled, rounded chips (Scholarships, Pending, Verified) have the same look as primary buttons. Teens on mobile tap them repeatedly.
patterns.recommendation: Give non-interactive chips a flat, outline-free, low-saturation style and never the primary brand color. Reserve filled brand color for actions only, in the design system.

findings.title: Sidebar blinks every time a page opens
findings.personaVoice: Every time I open something the menu on the left disappears for a moment. Is it reloading? Did I lose something?
findings.observation: The left sidebar disappears for ~120 ms and reappears on every navigation (remount).
findings.evidence: glitch images at ~1.2 s after load on 3 screens; DOM remount of nav#sidebar
findings.recommendation: Keep the sidebar persistent across page changes; only the main content area should update.
